$comment: WHERE the bridge reads each protocol schema's payload (or builds it, for a *Params schema): named functions of bridge/src, or a whole file when the file reads nothing else. Consumed by the coverage truth guard (test/coverage-truth.test.ts, V3): inside these sites a field name is THAT schema's field, so a field the PROMISED version's coverage manifest declares gap or ignored and that a site touches is a false declaration — unless the entry declares the reader (knownReaders) or the group declares the name a homonym at that site (another object's field, with why). The guard also refuses a schema the bridge reads (a handled field) that is neither scoped here nor listed in `unscoped` with why; `unscoped` can only shrink (FROZEN_UNSCOPED in the test). `emissionStreams` ties a coverage schema that describes agent `data` to its stream in the emission registry (protocol/openclaw/emissions/<version>.json), whose classification it must not contradict.

homonyms.ChatFinalEvent.agentId: projectChat reads agentId on its DELTA branch only (the base a delta appends to); a final returns before it
homonyms.ChatAbortedEvent.agentId: projectChat reads agentId on its DELTA branch only (the base a delta appends to); an aborted frame returns before it
homonyms.ChatErrorEvent.agentId: projectChat reads agentId on its DELTA branch only (the base a delta appends to); an error frame returns before it
homonyms.ChatStatusEvent.agentId: projectChat reads agentId on its DELTA branch only (the base a delta appends to); a status frame returns before it

homonyms.HelloOk.type: `frame.type` at this site is the response ENVELOPE's discriminant (res / event), read before the hello-ok payload; the payload's own `type` is not read

homonyms.SessionRow.label: `label` at this site is a thinking level's label (`o.label` of thinkingLevels), not the session's own label

homonyms.AgentSummary.kind: `config.kind` at this site is the bridge's own instance configuration (openclaw / hermes), not an agent row's kind

homonyms.CronJob.sessionKey: `.sessionKey` at this site is the job OWNER's (owner.sessionKey, kept as ownerSessionKey), not the job's own sessionKey

unscoped.ChatSendParams: built inline in performSendComposed (server.ts), a route function whose object literals carry many payloads at once: no site isolates this schema until its builder is a function of its own
unscoped.SessionsPatchParams: built inline in several server.ts route functions (applySessionSettings, performSendComposed) that write other payloads too: no site isolates this schema until its builder is a function of its own
unscoped.CronGetParams: built inline in performOpenClawCronManage (server.ts), which builds every cron.* request: no site isolates one schema until each builder is a function of its own
unscoped.CronListParams: built inline in fetchCronJobs (server.ts), which also reads the cron.list reply: no site isolates the params until the builder is a function of its own
unscoped.CronRemoveParams: built inline in performOpenClawCronManage (server.ts), which builds every cron.* request: no site isolates one schema until each builder is a function of its own
unscoped.CronRunParams: built inline in performOpenClawCronManage (server.ts), which builds every cron.* request: no site isolates one schema until each builder is a function of its own
unscoped.CronRunsParams: built inline in performOpenClawCronManage (server.ts), which builds every cron.* request: no site isolates one schema until each builder is a function of its own
unscoped.CronUpdateParams: built inline in performOpenClawCronManage (server.ts), which builds every cron.* request: no site isolates one schema until each builder is a function of its own
unscoped.ModelsListParams: built from modelsQuery's decision inside the models cache (models-roster.ts askModels), whose names are the catalogue's too: no site isolates the params until the builder is a function of its own
unscoped.TalkClientCreateResult: read inline in the talk routes of createBridgeServer (server.ts), the bridge's whole HTTP surface: no site isolates this schema until its reader is a function of its own
unscoped.TalkClientToolCallResult: read inline in the talk routes of createBridgeServer (server.ts), the bridge's whole HTTP surface: no site isolates this schema until its reader is a function of its own
unscoped.AgentsFilesSetParams: built inline in performAgentFilesOp (conf.ts), which builds the whole agents.files.* trio and reads their replies: no site isolates this schema until its builder is a function of its own
